name: ExecuteScript

parameters.help_en:
The database ID.

Call these operations to obtain the database ID: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141869.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID。
该参数对应为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141869.html等接口中的DatabaseId参数，您可以调用这些接口获取
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The SQL script to execute. You can specify Data Query Language (DQL), Data Definition Language (DDL), or Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements. The ability to execute DDL and DML statements depends on the instance's security settings
parameters.help_zh: 要执行的具体SQL脚本。包括DQL、DDL和DML，其中DDL和DML是否允许依赖于实例的安全管控配置
parameters.name: script

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the database is a logical database
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

To view the tenant ID, move the cursor over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the API caller.<props="china"> For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html。</props>
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

Results.description_en: The script execution results. Each object in the array represents the result of a single script
Results.description_zh: 脚本执行返回结果列表，列表中每一项对应一个脚本执行结果

ColumnNames.description_en: A list of column names returned from a DQL script execution
ColumnNames.description_zh: 执行查询脚本时，返回的结果集字段列表

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the execution fails
Message.description_zh: 执行失败时，返回的错误信息

Rows.description_en: The data rows returned from a DQL script execution
Rows.description_zh: 执行查询脚本时，返回的结果数据行

items.description_en: A data row from the result set
items.description_zh: 执行查询脚本时，返回的结果数据

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the individual script was successfully executed
Success.description_zh: 单个脚本执行是否成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
